attempts.summary: On node1, cron scheduling is now restricted to root and opsadmin via /etc/cron.allow. opsadmin user was created (did not previously exist). Verified via a throwaway test user that non-listed users are denied by crontab, and that opsadmin/root are permitted, both before and after a full node restart (boot_id changed from f9bf293d... to 72810ce8...), confirming persistence and cron service recovery.
